sentences.sentence: I saw a handsome, young, Korean pirate.
He was a funny, old pirate with a long, black beard.
He was wearing long, black pants and a white, cotton shirt.
He had a big, brown, wooden ship.
The pirate's pet was a small, cute, green parrot.
Overall, he was a weird and smelly pirate.
I would like to meet an interesting British pirate.
I don't want to meet a scary, mean, old pirate.
